headline: AFF AI CLUB charges into ARC-3 gold at 10th

sections.text: AFF AI CLUB surged from 30th to 10th, gaining 5.06 points to reach 38.98 and move into the gold places.
The move puts AFF AI CLUB among the top 18 teams currently occupying the public board’s gold places. The standings are provisional; medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
